data.title: Änderungsbescheid: Recalculated Bürgergeld benefits
data.summary: Jobcenter Musterlingen recalculated the person's Bürgergeld benefits for the period 1 November 2025 to 30 April 2026 due to changed heating-cost advance payments, setting the new monthly total at €1,126.40 from 1 November 2025. The letter also asks for bank statements of the last three months to be submitted by 5 November 2025.
data.explanation: The Jobcenter has changed the amount of Bürgergeld paid because of updated heating-cost advances (Heizkostenabschläge). To keep receiving payments from December onward, submit the requested bank statements (Kontoauszüge) covering the last three months by the stated date — otherwise benefits may not be continued. If the person disagrees with this decision, they may file an objection (Widerspruch) with the Jobcenter; the app shows until when this can be done. No other action is needed for the recalculated payment itself, which should arrive automatically.

key_facts.label: Benefit period (Zeitraum)
key_facts.quote: die Leistungen für den Zeitraum 01.11.2025 bis 30.04.2026 werden aufgrund der geänderten Heizkostenabschläge neu berechnet.

key_facts.label: Deadline to submit bank statements
key_facts.quote: Bitte reichen Sie bis zum 05.11.2025 die Kontoauszüge der letzten drei Monate ein.

items.title: Submit bank statements (Kontoauszüge) of the last three months
items.action: Send copies of the bank statements (Kontoauszüge) for the last three months to the Jobcenter.
items.consequence: Without these documents, the benefits cannot continue to be approved from December onward.
items.quote: Bitte reichen Sie bis zum 05.11.2025 die Kontoauszüge der letzten drei Monate ein.

items.title: Decide whether to file an objection (Widerspruch)
items.action: Decide whether to object (Widerspruch) to this decision, and if so, submit it in writing or for the record to the Jobcenter by the deadline shown.
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid kann jede betroffene Person innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe Widerspruch erheben.
